title: Normalized scalar family and coherence records
statement: For the coefficient and exact extension data of [def-sp-field-scalar-system-data] and the coordinate and reduction data of [def-sp-field-scalar-reduction-data], define ScalarData to bundle these four components for one inclusion. A Compositor consists of ordinary and derived natural tensor composition isomorphisms satisfying the cochain counit equation. IntegralCompositor and SystemCompositor specialize it to completed coefficients and whole strict towers. Successive specifies both compositors, their multiplication laws on local tensor generators, and the whole-derived-system reduction square. Identity specifies the ordinary multiplication unitors, their derived counit equations, and the reduction square. Family chooses ScalarData for every finite coefficient field inclusion, asserts Nonempty Identity and Successive for those choices, and asserts ell is a unit times a positive uniformizer power with the corresponding ideal-power equalities. These are the existing records formerly declared in the normalized-systems module; no data, equation, or signature changes.
